info.long_name: Medicaid and CHIP Youth Wellbeing Rate
info.short_description: Percentage of Medicaid and CHIP child beneficiaries who received youth wellbeing services.
info.long_description: State-level youth wellbeing rates for Medicaid and CHIP child beneficiaries, from the Medicaid and CHIP Child Core Set Quality Measures voluntarily reported by states to CMS (2014–2023). Includes adolescent well-care visits (AWC: percent of adolescents who had at least one comprehensive well-care visit), developmental screening (DEV: percent of children screened for developmental delays by age 3), weight assessment and counseling for children (WCC: percent of children with BMI percentile, physical activity counseling, and nutrition counseling documented), well-child visits in the first 15 months (W15), well-child visits ages 3-4 (W34), children's access to primary care (CAP: percent of children who had a visit with a PCP during the measurement year), ADHD medication follow-up (ADD: percent of children prescribed ADHD medication with a follow-up visit within 30 days), follow-up after ED visit for mental illness (FUM: percent of children with a follow-up visit within 30 days after an ED visit for mental illness), and follow-up after hospitalization for mental illness (FUH: percent of children with a follow-up visit within 30 days after hospitalization for mental illness). Reporting is voluntary; not all states report all measures each year.
